questions.question: King Ahab asked his four hundred prophets if he should go to war against Ramoth-gilead. They told him not to go. True or false?
In a vision, Micaiah saw a spirit go into the mouths of King Ahab's prophets. What kind of spirit was it?
When enemy chariot commanders turned to attack King Jehoshaphat of Judah in battle, what happened?

answers.text: He cried out and the LORD helped him
He threw off his royal robes and ran
He hid behind the chariot of Ahab

questions.question: King Ahab of Israel died at sunset after fighting the Arameans at Ramoth-gilead. True or false?
